subject: More days in output than exist in the raw data file?

messages.author: e5b9e6a13d6fc253
messages.subject: More days in output than exist in the raw data file?
parts:
Hello,

I have an ActiGraph .gt3x file with 52 days of recorded data in it as checked through ActiLife and read.gt3x and the start and end date both match. However, when I run this file through GGIR, I get 85 days worth of output. The start date is correct but the end date goes well past the end date in the file.  I cannot figure out how or why this is happening and where the additional days are coming from. Possibly an issue with imputation? The idle sleep mode feature was enabled for this collection period but I have never seen this type of issue with other ISM affected data and this is the only file in this dataset that seems to have this issue. 

I have attached a reprex of the dates in the .gt3x file read with read.gt3x, part 2 day summary output run only on this file showing the additional days, and a copy of the config file. Any input into what may be happening is appreciated.

Thanks,

Sam

messages.author: 4b9dc262ec278dc5
messages.subject: Re: More days in output than exist in the raw data file?
parts:
Hi Samuel,

Did you check is the sampling frequency is correctly identified in GGIR? I guess this is ok, but just in case (it might produce a mismatch in the timestamps). In the case that the idle sleep mode was activated during the data collection, I would also check whether the idle periods were correctly identified. I can have a look at the file if you are able to share it.

Best,
Jairo

messages.subject: Re: More days in output than exist in the raw data file?
parts:
Thanks for the help, Jairo. I can confirm that updating to the latest development version of GGIR (3.2.1) and running GGIR with the default arguments resolved the discrepancy I was having. 

Cheers,

Sam
